definitions.explanation: An organization established with donated funds for charitable, educational, cultural, or other public purposes.

examples.japanese: {財団|ざいだん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{奨学金|しょうがくきん}→奨学金：03230_shougakukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a scholarship from the foundation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{財団|ざいだん}{法人|ほうじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{運営|うんえい}している→運営する：21987_uneisuru⟧。
examples.english: This art museum is operated by an incorporated foundation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{財産|ざいさん}→財産：01635_zaisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{財団|ざいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}した→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧。
examples.english: He used his own wealth to establish a foundation for educational support.

notes:
{財団|ざいだん} refers to an organization funded by donated assets for public benefit.

FORMS:
{財|ざい} (wealth, assets) + ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ (group, organization)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {財団|ざいだん}{法人|ほうじん}: incorporated foundation
- ⟦{公益|こうえき}→公益：16061_koueki⟧{財団|ざいだん}: public interest foundation
- {財団|ざいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧: to establish a foundation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{社団|しゃだん}→社団：24186_shadan⟧: association (people-based organization)
- {財団|ざいだん}: foundation (asset-based organization)
- NPO/NGO: nonprofit organization
